visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven current portable views against individually viewed Qualla south/street/courtyard/block-detail originals, HABS elevation and the published 1928 floor plan. Stepped room masses, projecting dining window, high living transom, long rear gallery, motor court, bridge, garage and retaining walls remain distinct. Final review includes the northwest boundary-wall return and stepped living-window surround.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven current shared-material views, including map overlay and full front. Concrete, roof membrane and painted metal use three shared metric surfaces; glass and pool water are separate local materials. Flat-ground fixtures expose subterranean retaining geometry and elevated street walls; actual terrain contact is assessed in portable/context views.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen current lighting, quality and forced-detail views. Skyline retains articulated masses, compound openings and retaining silhouette. District restores glazing, roof parapets, bridge screen and stepped window surround; street restores selected joints and relief; closeup restores the full block-course grid, repeated Greek-key-derived motifs and leaded-glass detail. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures. No physical-device performance measurement is claimed.

geographicReview.notes: Mapped combined compound footprint controls the court, terrace edges and northwest street return; it is not extruded as a single roof. Anchor [-118.2929,34.11622], heading -0.39: +X east-southeast, +Z south-southwest. Unmodified USGS CA_LosAngeles_B23 bare-earth GeoTIFF is retained; datum 255.9812 m NAVD88 at motor-court local [-18,2]. Foundations extend to -10 m and the street return rises with the hillside. Main upper floor is 3.25 m above the court. Ground beneath buildings is source-interpolated; placement remains approximate and host-dependent, with footprint replacement disabled.

fidelityReview.scope: Main Ennis House, connected garage/servants wing and bridge, motor court, north pool terrace, scenic retaining walls and northwest boundary return. No interiors or neighboring properties.
fidelityReview.notes: Two primary and five supplemental local photographs, HABS CA-1942 measured elevation/description, 1928 Architectural Record floor plan/perspective and satellite roof context establish the articulated compound. Block module is 16 inches; repeated relief, leaded glass, hidden joins and room/roof dimensions are medium-fi interpretations, not a measured survey or photogrammetry. No photo pixels, scaffolding, vegetation, visitors, vehicles or furniture copied.
